div.div: Security group: inbound 22 (SSH) from the administrator's address, 80 (HTTP) and 443 (HTTPS) from anywhere. PostgreSQL and gunicorn listen on 127.0.0.1 only, so neither is reachable from outside the instance.

div.div:
Public name
The name a-b-c-d.sslip.io is answered by the public sslip.io DNS with the address a.b.c.d of the instance. The instance holds the Elastic IP 44.206.186.9, so the name 44-206-186-9.sslip.io, the certificate and ALLOWED_HOSTS survive a restart of the instance.

div.div:
Where the project stands, 5 November 2026
Deployed on one EC2 instance of the AWS Academy Learner Lab and reached over HTTPS.
nginx is read from the Server header of the live site. Python and PostgreSQL are the Ubuntu 26.04 packages, 3.14 and 18 by distribution default. The Python libraries are installed from requirements.txt when the instance is updated, so their patch level follows its ranges.
The test suite runs in CI on Python 3.12 and PostgreSQL 17, and locally on PostgreSQL 17 in Docker.
